attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL10) serving AMQP over TLS on port 5671 using a purpose-built CA. Plain AMQP (5672) is disabled entirely; only mTLS clients presenting a certificate issued by the cluster CA can connect (ssl_options.verify=verify_peer, fail_if_no_peer_cert=true). The management UI (15672) is bound to each node's private IP and firewalld-restricted via rich rules to only the three cluster node IPs, with no broader allow rule. All three nodes were rolling-restarted one at a time (quorum preserved via pause_minority partition handling), with boot-id changes proven and post-restart cluster health plus live TLS+mTLS AMQP publish/consume verified on every node.
